title: Deleting one point from a 0-dimensional integer multiplicity triple
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U 0 (as frozen in the contract; H⁰ = μHE[0], μ_R = R.measure = θ·H⁰⌞M, and R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(z)·ξ(z)(ω(z)) dH⁰(z)), and x ∈ M. Then there is R' ∈ IMRep U 0 with carrier M ∖ {x} such that μ_R = μ_{R'} + θ(x)·δ_x as measures on ℝ^P, and R'.action(ω) = R.action(ω) − θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) for every ω ∈ 𝒟⁰(U) (TestFormOn U 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U 0) (x : Euclid P), x ∈ R.carrier → ∃ R' : IMRep U 0, R'.carrier = R.carrier \ {x} ∧ R.measure = R'.measure + (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) • Measure.dirac x ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, R'.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) = R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) - (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) x)
